coverage.evidence: server/src/NomNomzBot.Application/Abstractions/Templating/TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:381-592 registers every helper on the page as a bare Literal key with no arguments, and the only field forms are Prefixed obs.event.<field> and vts.event.<field> (578-592); provider at 219; the page lists exactly these 33 keys.

Values come from the handlers: TwitchSubTier.ToLabel 1/2/3/Prime (Rewards/EventHandlers/SubscriptionEventHandlers.cs:25-33), DiscordTierLabel Tier 1 (Discord/EventHandlers/DiscordTierLabel.cs:18-25), AlsoSaidClause leading space and They also said (Platform/Eventing/AlsoSaidClause.cs:22-23), followed_at ToString("O") on a DateTimeOffset (Community/EventHandlers/FollowEventHandlers.cs:44, Domain FollowEvent.cs:36), cheer emotes stripped (CheerEventHandler.cs:45-53, CheermoteText.cs:22-29), and a helper nobody fills prints exactly as typed (TemplateResolver.cs:154-166, TemplateTreeRenderer source text when null).

TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:102-126 sets the context groups (EventSourceOnly = event response + pipeline; plus Discord; stream lifecycle + Discord), and provider is event response only (219). Every Use in cell in the page table matches lines 381-592. Command saves are checked against the Command context (Infrastructure/Commands/CommandService.cs:668-691).

server/src/NomNomzBot.Application/Commands/Services/EventResponsePresetCatalog.cs:54-210 gives each event's variables, which match each per-event sentence on the page. The Your line help reads You can use: {names} from those preset variables (dashboard event-responses/components/EventResponseEditor.vue:111-119, i18n/en.json:52-53). A copied {tier} is rejected by TemplateHelperValidator.cs:46-73, and the error names where it works (TemplateSurfaceAvailability.cs:144-155). The event labels match dashboard event-responses/i18n/en.json:8-35.

SubscriptionEventHandlers.cs:156-165: months = CumulativeMonths, streak = StreakMonths, message empty when null, also_said. Gift recipients are not announced as new subs (65). The gift batch fills tier, count and anonymous, and an anonymous gifter's name is Anonymous (204-217). Gift received fills gifter (Anonymous when anonymous), gifter.id (empty when anonymous), tier and anonymous (106-114). The separate anonymous responses come from ResponseKeyFor (89-90, 191-192). Held text clears message and also_said (TwitchAlertHandlerBase.cs:84-103), and the same holds for input (RewardRedeemedHandler.cs:147-161).

server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Supporters/EventHandlers/SupporterTriggerSource.cs:60-62 runs the supporter.<kind> response and then supporter.any. In 65-77, user is the supporter name, and currency, tier, quantity and message are empty when the service sends none. FormatAmount minor/100 with format 0.## (80-83) gives 5 and 12.5. The kinds tip, membership, merch and charity are in EventResponsePresetCatalog.cs:178-182.

server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Moderation/EventHandlers/ModerationAlertHandlers.cs:62 gives permanent for a ban. A timeout shares channel.ban and uses HumanDuration (85, 111), which gives whole minutes or else seconds (TwitchAlertHandlerBase.cs:141-150). Stream end gives hh:mm:ss (Stream/EventHandlers/ChannelOfflineHandler.cs:176), and Discord stream end gives Nh Nm (Discord/EventHandlers/DiscordStreamEndNotificationHandler.cs:54-57). Unban fills moderator only (156-160), and responses go out only for the bot's own actions (RespondsLive 48-49, 97-98, 147-148).

reader_answers.evidence: The helpers are bare Literal keys with no arguments (TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:381-575), and Your line lists the event's preset variables (EventResponseEditor.vue:111-119).

Event helpers are limited to the event response and pipeline contexts, and some add Discord (TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:102-126). Viewer-written input is resolved through the viewer-template service (RewardRedeemedHandler.cs:145-159).
A token the evaluator cannot fill returns null (TemplateResolver.cs:154-166), and the renderer then prints its source text (TemplateTreeRenderer raw placeholder), so the braces stay.

CommandService.cs:668-691 checks command saves against the Command context, and tier is not registered there (TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:388-393), so the save fails. DescribeMissing returns 'It works in: event responses, pipelines, Discord notifications' (TemplateSurfaceAvailability.cs:144-155).
